desc: For over half a century CCI has been producing the undeniably, undisputedly best small caliber rimfire ammunition in the world. With unparalleled quality and flawless performance, CCI has solidified their position at the very top of the rimfire market. Ask anyone that shoots small caliber rimfire which ammo is the best and you will find there is only one answer, CCI. Pick up some CCI and see for yourself why this is the Best small caliber target and hunting ammunition that money can buy.
